notes.title: Update & Regional Availability
notes.notes:
Game Update
A new update is now live. Changes include:

    Minor update to translation in chapter 8
    Fix to a text rending bug in chapters 2 & 5
    Fix to a text error that affected some single quotes


Regional Availability Issue Update
Regional availability has been corrected, but there are reports of no launch discount for those regions. We've contacted valve for them to correct this issue. Update: The launch discount issue has been fixed and is now available in all regions!
